g.text: 01 / CHICAGO CRIME & MOBILITY
Containerized data platform asking whether crime near Divvy bike-share stations affects ridership.
Batch Spark crime ingestion + streaming Kafka→Spark for Divvy GBFS, dbt transforms, BigQuery ML, Grafana.
PYTHON · SPARK · KAFKA · DBT · AIRFLOW · BIGQUERY · DOCKER · TERRAFORM · GRAFANA
02 / NYC TAXI ANALYTICS
Production-grade ELT pipeline for 2025 NYC Taxi Trip Records on GCP with Terraform-provisioned infra.
Airbyte ingestion → BigQuery raw → dbt star-schema marts with schema tests and GitHub Actions CI.
PYTHON · AIRFLOW · AIRBYTE · DBT · BIGQUERY · GCP · TERRAFORM · DOCKER
03 / YOUTUBE ANALYTICS ELT
Containerized ELT pipeline pulling YouTube Data API v3 analytics into multi-layer PostgreSQL via Airflow.
Dynamic playlist discovery, batched stats extraction, Soda Core quality gates, full CI/CD with DockerHub.
PYTHON · AIRFLOW · POSTGRESQL · DOCKER · REDIS · SODA CORE · GITHUB ACTIONS
04 / REAL-TIME WEATHER ANALYTICS
ELT pipeline ingesting live weather from Weatherstack API into PostgreSQL, transformed by dbt into marts.
Airflow + Redis broker orchestration, Docker-out-of-Docker dbt, Superset dashboards for trends.
PYTHON · AIRFLOW · DBT · POSTGRESQL · DOCKER · REDIS · APACHE SUPERSET
05 / FORMULA 1 DATA PLATFORM
End-to-end F1 data platform ingesting Ergast datasets into Azure with Medallion Architecture (B→S→G).
Databricks notebooks with Spark/PySpark, ADF orchestration, Key Vault credentials, Delta Lake ACID upserts.
AZURE DATABRICKS · PYSPARK · DELTA LAKE · AZURE ADF · ADLS GEN2 · KEY VAULT
06 / F1 LAKEHOUSE GOVERNANCE
Azure Databricks lakehouse with centralized Unity Catalog governance across Bronze/Silver/Gold schemas.
Automated Databricks Workflows DAG orchestration, Delta Lake managed tables, snake_case cleansing layer.
AZURE DATABRICKS · PYSPARK · DELTA LAKE · UNITY CATALOG · ADLS GEN2
07 / AIRBNB ANALYTICS ENGINEERING
dbt transformation pipeline across Staging, Core, and Mart layers on Snowflake with SCD Type 2 snapshots.
Incremental fact tables with surrogate keys, dbt_expectations quality checks, Dagster asset orchestration.
DBT · SNOWFLAKE · DAGSTER · PYTHON · DBT_EXPECTATIONS · JINJA
08 / BITCOIN WHALE ANALYTICS
dbt pipeline flattening nested Bitcoin transaction outputs via SQL LATERAL FLATTEN into whale-address marts.
Identifies high-value (>10 BTC) addresses, top-10 by volume, SCD Type 2 snapshots, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
DBT · SNOWFLAKE · SQL · JINJA · GITHUB ACTIONS · LOOKER STUDIO
09 / OKF-CV RESUME ENGINE
Hybrid search resume tailoring system combining OKF 4-layer phrase matching with Zvec semantic embeddings.
Local TCP embedding daemon, self-learning keyword enrichment, LaTeX/ReportLab PDF compilation pipeline.
PYTHON · SENTENCE-TRANSFORMERS · ZVEC · LATEX · EMBEDDINGS · HYBRID SEARCH
10 / DACH ATS RESUME OPTIMIZER
Streamlit web app automating resume and cover letter tailoring for German/DACH ATS systems via 6-stage pipeline.
Interactive decision terminal, LaTeX PDF compilation, OpenCode Go LLM routing, visual layout audit.
STREAMLIT · PYTHON · LATEX · OPENAI · ANTHROPIC · DACH ATS
11 / PDF RAG QA SYSTEM
End-to-end RAG pipeline ingesting PDFs via PyPDF2, embedding with OpenAI, indexing in local FAISS vector store.
LangChain stuff QA chain with GPT for grounded, context-aware answers from semantic similarity search.
PYTHON · LANGCHAIN · OPENAI · FAISS · PYPDF2 · RAG
12 / ROBUST PCA (COMAD)
Research project reimplementing PCA using median-based Co-Median Absolute Deviation matrix for outlier robustness.
Benchmarked across 9 datasets with classification, clustering, and statistical significance testing.
PYTHON · SCIKIT-LEARN · NUMPY · PANDAS · PCA · KNN · SVM
13 / ADVENTURE WORKS DASHBOARD
Power BI dashboard for a global cycling manufacturer with Star Schema model and advanced DAX time intelligence.
Three-page report with What-If price-adjustment slicer, return-rate analysis, and 110% growth target tracking.
POWER BI · DAX · POWER QUERY (M) · STAR SCHEMA · WHAT-IF PARAMETERS
